guidance: A field reader, not a validator: the pasted bytes are trusted, and a data unit that parses is not necessarily one a neighbour would accept. TTL renewal timing, checksum handling, transmit intervals and whether the advertisement is policy-compliant are outside the page. Identifier strings are decoded as printable ASCII with other bytes shown as \xNN rather than guessed at, and organizationally specific values whose OUI this page does not name are shown as hex. The page makes no capture, reads no interface and sends nothing.
method: Each TLV is a 16-bit header holding a 7-bit type and a 9-bit information-string length, followed by that many value octets, as IEEE 802.1AB defines them. An LLDPDU must begin with the Chassis ID (type 1), Port ID (type 2) and Time To Live (type 3) TLVs in that order, so a different first, second or third type is refused with the byte offset; the optional types are Port Description (4), System Name (5), System Description (6), System Capabilities (7), Management Address (8) and Organizationally Specific (127), and the data unit ends at type 0 with a zero length. The Chassis ID subtypes are 1 chassis component, 2 interface alias, 3 port component, 4 MAC address, 5 network address, 6 interface name and 7 locally assigned, while the Port ID subtypes replace 4 with agent circuit ID at 3 and network address at 4; a MAC address must be exactly six octets and a network address starts with an IANA address-family octet. The System Capabilities value is two 16-bit bitmaps, supported then enabled, with bit 0 other, 1 repeater, 2 bridge, 3 WLAN access point, 4 router, 5 telephone, 6 DOCSIS cable device, 7 station only, 8 C-VLAN component, 9 S-VLAN component and 10 two-port MAC relay. A Management Address value starts with an address-string length (1 to 31), an address-family subtype, the address, an interface numbering subtype, a 4-octet interface number, an OID length and the OID. An organizationally specific value is a 3-octet OUI and a subtype: 00-12-0F is IEEE 802.3, whose subtype 1 carries the autonegotiation flag byte (bit 0 supported, bit 1 enabled), the 16-bit advertised PMD capability and the 16-bit operational MAU type, and whose subtype 4 carries the 16-bit maximum frame size; 00-80-C2 is IEEE 802.1, whose subtype 1 carries the 16-bit port VLAN ID; and 00-12-BB is TIA TR-41 for LLDP-MED inventory strings. A time to live of 0 is a shutdown advertisement, and a normal value is renewed at one quarter of it under the default hold multiplier of 4. Frame mode reads the 14-octet Ethernet header, skips up to two 802.1Q tags and requires EtherType 0x88CC. Values the page does not decode are shown as hex, and everything runs in the browser with no network access.
